channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Nov 07
item.description:
7 development commits

Monuments & World

  • Fixed terrain clipping in Nuclear Missile Silo doorways and underground tunnels, preventing doors from being blocked by terrain.

Bug Fixes

  • Encryption level is now applied on the network thread, preventing premature encryption setup and ensuring packet batches are flushed before sending, reducing connection errors.
  • DirectDraw objects no longer render when attached to entities that haven’t been networked to the client yet, fixing visual glitches.

item.title: Rust Development Updates — Nov 06
item.description:
45 development commits

Equipment & Wearables

  • Night vision goggles no longer get stuck and will work correctly; NVG scientist suits now display glowing eyes after head removal.

Base & Deployables

  • Sleeping bags cannot be placed where a player wouldn't fit and you cannot respawn on a sleeping bag that would trap you; a warning appears if placement would block respawn.

World & Visuals

  • Overly bright floating city flares have been toned down, improving visibility.

UI & Inventory

  • Watercatcher loot panel now automatically selects the bucket when it’s in the belt (also fixes chicken coop trough selection).

Map & Navigation

  • Vending machine markers now appear above generic markers after reopening the map.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Restores the disabled blueprint tooltip, clearly showing why a blueprint cannot be learned.
  • Fixes the flamethrower fuel gauge needle to accurately track fuel levels.
  • Recreates the inventory preview model after a map reload, preventing missing player preview.
